1. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use and __wherein the control means is configured to enable varying pressure levels in the brake chamber__.

2. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, __wherein the plural first valves and/or plural second valves are configured for sequential and parallel operation__.

3. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger valves are positioned to optimize airflow during high demand scenarios__.

4. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed __to facilitate rapid pressure adjustments in the brake chamber__.

5. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, __wherein the binary actuators provide enhanced responsiveness to control signals__.

6. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __wherein the control means further integrates data from environmental sensors to adjust braking performance__.

7. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, __wherein the control means is configured to adjust braking based on real-time vehicular dynamics__.

8. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein adjustments are made on-the-fly to ensure optimal braking performance under variable driving conditions__.

9. (Currently Amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the air system is configured to operate efficiently across multiple braking scenarios__.
